intent.verbatim: a contract's checks have to actually run — verify executes each run command and judges on exit code, never blesses whatever was built
intent.decoded: `socom contract verify` runs a contract's auto checks (PASS/FAIL on exit) and `show` renders it — the SOCOM-native conformance runner that makes done-ness falsifiable.

contract.goal: verify executes a contract's checks and show renders it, both exiting clean on a green contract.

check.expect: exit 0: every auto check of a green contract passes
exit 0: the contract renders (ref, goal, checks)

contract.out-of-scope: Comparing live output against the prose expect; verify judges on exit code.
contract.regression-surface: A failing auto check must make verify exit nonzero (fail-closed).
